system.description:
Once per turn, when you cast a Ninjutsu, you can gain Discipline in place of casting a Bukijutsu. If you gained Discipline as a result of the Discipline class feature by casting a Bukijutsu with the Chain keyword already this turn, you cannot gain Discipline by casting a Ninjutsu the same turn. You cannot use Discipline Illusions in the same turn you use this Kata.

You gain a number of Discipline based on the rank of the Ninjutsu Cast; (D-Rank/C-Rank: 1 Discipline, B-Rank/A-Rank: 2 Discipline, S-Rank: 3 Discipline)
